verdict.rationale: Unity ships an official in-editor AI Assistant (docs-14, docs-24) that uses natural-language prompts to create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions, plus an official MCP integration (docs-23, probe-4) connecting LLM agents to the Editor. However, the docs don't explicitly confirm script-generation or API Q&A use cases, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of assistant quality (only pricing/credit mentions). missing for 10: explicit evidence of script generation, API-question answering, independent hands-on validation of the assistant's usefulness.
